label: Bug / regression / reliability fix
operational_definition: Restores or corrects existing behavior, reliability, error handling, or a regression without primarily adding a new product surface.

label: Feature / capability addition
operational_definition: Adds or materially expands an externally usable feature, integration, provider, command, UI workflow, API surface, plugin, or adapter.

label: Compatibility / migration / platform adaptation
operational_definition: Adapts existing functionality to a platform, version, format, migration, or compatibility requirement without the new capability itself being primary.

label: Dependency / package/toolchain maintenance
operational_definition: Updates dependencies, package managers, framework/runtime versions, build/lint/bundle tooling, or related package metadata.

label: Security hardening / vulnerability remediation
operational_definition: Primarily remediates a security weakness or strengthens authentication, authorization, validation, isolation, or security boundaries.

label: Internal engineering / test / CI maintenance
operational_definition: Primarily changes tests, CI, documentation, developer tooling, diagnostics, governance, or internal refactoring rather than product behavior.

label: Problem only
operational_definition: States the problem or desired outcome without proposing a concrete implementation route.

label: Suggests solution
operational_definition: Proposes one or more possible approaches, but leaves meaningful implementation choice open.

label: Explicit instruction
operational_definition: Specifies a concrete mechanism, exact change, files/APIs/configuration, detailed acceptance criteria, or implementation steps.

label: Aligned
operational_definition: The PR stated goal directly addresses the issue request.

label: Expanded
operational_definition: The PR addresses the issue but materially broadens its stated scope with adjacent work.

label: Diverged
operational_definition: The PR stated goal is materially different from the issue request.

label: Unclear
operational_definition: Available blind issue/PR text is insufficient to determine the relationship confidently.

label: Capability / integration expansion
operational_definition: Adds or materially expands an externally usable feature, integration, provider, command, UI workflow, API surface, plugin, or adapter; supporting config/tests/docs do not override it.

label: Dependency / build / toolchain change
operational_definition: Dominant change updates/replaces dependencies, package managers, framework/runtime versions, build/lint/bundle/declaration tooling, compatibility matrices, or related lock/package metadata.

label: Behavior / reliability correction
operational_definition: Changes existing runtime behavior, parsing, matching, lifecycle, error handling, recovery, or control flow without primarily adding a new product surface.

label: Data / persistence / state management
operational_definition: Dominant change concerns durable state: schemas/migrations, storage locations/formats, checkpoints, caches, session state, backups, or recovery of stored state.

label: Runtime / infrastructure / configuration change
operational_definition: Dominant change modifies deployment/runtime environment, VM/container/process/network infrastructure, environment/config resolution, installation/distribution mode, or platform wiring.

label: Validation / access / boundary control
operational_definition: Dominant change validates, restricts, sanitizes, authenticates, or otherwise controls input, paths, networks, permissions, destinations, or access boundaries.

label: Internal tooling / CI / refactor
operational_definition: Dominant change targets developer/testing/CI/diagnostic tooling or reorganizes internal architecture/code structure rather than primarily changing product behavior.
